structured-data.action: index metadata representations for all currently cataloged Sensor Hub deployment-property datasets while keeping raw time-series payloads out of the text RAG index; keep the CSV demo as one additional structured source
structured-data.target: at least 32 distinct versioned structured datasets with non-empty RAG evidence
structured-data.selection_rule: all eligible Sensor Hub datasets present before the V2 corpus snapshot is frozen

software-documentation.action: no corpus expansion required before query authoring
software-documentation.target: retain at least 80 distinct indexed GitHub file paths
software-documentation.selection_rule: use the frozen repository corpus produced by the GitHub adapter and record repository HEAD/content provenance

institutional-documents.action: index a deterministic public FOI document subset before query authoring
institutional-documents.target: at least 40 successfully indexed distinct FOI documents
institutional-documents.selection_rule: rank eligible catalog identifiers by SHA-256(identifier), attempt indexing in that deterministic order, and continue until 40 documents are successfully indexed; failures are recorded and the next ranked candidate is tried

guardrails: Do not inspect retrieval-profile results while selecting the corpus expansion subset.
Do not choose FOI documents because they produce convenient or high-performing retrieval examples.
Do not text-embed raw Sensor Hub observation streams for this benchmark; use catalog metadata as the RAG evidence representation for metadata-first sensor datasets.
Pilot P1 remains bound to its original snapshot and must not be recomputed on the expanded V2 corpus as if it were the same pilot.
After expansion, rerun the capacity audit. Query authoring begins only after all three source families pass the gate.
The final V2 corpus snapshot is frozen before confirmation queries are evaluated.
